jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

100% remote USA with some occasional client travel.
Why We’re Different:
Acliviti doesn’t just advise clients - we co-create their vision, align internal teams, and help them stay ahead of what’s next. We are a vendor-neutral consultancy that helps enterprise organizations define strategy, lead execution, and provide ongoing support - all while aligning stakeholders and delivering outcomes that matter.

We Are:
Experts in customer experience delivering operational and technical transformation
Strategic partners who stay engaged before, during, and after implementation to ensure objectives are achieved
Boardroom translators - connecting CX vision, technical platforms, and financial value
Outcome-driven professionals who know 95% of spend is on human capital, not just tech
Remote-first and cross-functional, with deep expertise across industries

Our Clients Are:
Enterprise organizations modernizing their customer engagement ecosystem
CX, IT, Operations, and Finance leaders seeking true stakeholder alignment
Teams navigating complex transformation programs with high visibility and high stakes
Businesses who need business cases, vendor guidance, and enterprise-class execution
Companies looking to optimize revenue & cost models, reduce friction, and drive customer growth

How We Solve:
We lead clients through a continuous improvement cycle with three integrated service areas:
Strategy: We help clients define where they’re going - and how to get there.
Customer Experience Design
Performance Optimization
Transformation Capabilities

Execution: We lead execution across people, platforms, and processes.
Technical Platform & Capabilities
Operational Management
Data & Analytics

Managed Solutions & Support: We stay engaged post-launch to ensure long-term success.
Operational & Technical Oversight
Outcome & Expense Management
Artificial Intelligence & Data Segmentation

Role Overview

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for leading value analysis and measurement across Acliviti's CX Strategy engagements, from initial assessment and business case development through implementation and post-go-live performance measurement.
This role translates business objectives and operational data into measurable outcomes: developing ROI models, defining KPIs and demonstrating the business value of CX and AI investments. The role gathers and standardizes performance data across client deployments and platforms, and will help shape the frameworks Acliviti uses to measure deployment performance across platforms, building the benchmarks and value measurement standards that guide client decisions.

Key Roles & Accountabilities

Value Strategy & ROI Analysis
Own end-to-end value analysis across client engagements, including baselines, success metrics, ROI models, and value realization plans.
Develop business cases and ROI models to support CX transformation and technology investment decisions.
Define KPIs and measurement frameworks to track business outcomes before and after implementation.
Lead data analysis for client assessments and translate findings into actionable business insights.

Deployment Performance Measurement
Gather, standardize and maintain performance data across client deployments and platforms, so results can be compared consistently.
Measure how deployments perform after go-live across technical, operational and customer experience dimensions, and report results to clients and internal teams.
Monitor performance trends, identify risks early, and give clear insight into what is driving client outcomes.
Play a key role in designing and building the firm’s cross-platform performance measurement approach as it evolves from analysis into a repeatable practice capability.
Work with Engineering on data connections, integrations and quality checks so performance data is accurate, documented and reliable.

Analytics, Reporting & Benchmarking
Build and maintain dashboards, analytical models, and reporting frameworks using multiple data sources.
Maintain industry benchmarks, performance targets, and measurement methodologies.
Analyze operational and CX performance data to identify opportunities for improvement and value creation.
Provide benchmark and pricing inputs to support proposals, solution design, and client engagements.

Client Engagement & Value Communication
Present analytical findings, ROI models, and performance results to client stakeholders.
Support business UAT by translating business objectives into measurable scenarios and success criteria.
Deliver 30/60/90-day post-implementation performance readouts.
Partner cross functionally to ensure value commitments are measurable and tracked.

Practice Development & Knowledge Sharing
Develop and maintain standardized value models, analytical templates, and benchmark libraries.
Establish quality standards for analytical deliverables and reporting.
Mentor and support analysts and CX Consultants in value analysis, measurement, and reporting practices.
Continuously improve Acliviti's value measurement methodologies and analytical capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial modeling, or value/ROI analysis.
Demonstrated experience building and managing production dashboards using multiple data sources.
Experience developing ROI models and business cases to support client investment decisions.
Strong understanding of contact center, CX, and conversational AI performance metrics.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings and business value to executive stakeholders.
Experience working collaboratively across business, technology, and consulting teams.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with statistical analysis, regression modeling, or predictive analytics.
Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other analysts.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, CBAP, or CCBA certification.

You will love our culture if you are:
An ambitious intrapreneur who loves building new things.
Someone that loves technology, process as well as numbers – and all the space in between – to figure out the right balance of features, functionality, and affordability for each client
Comfortable communicating through a variety of mediums with many different audiences and objectives
Great at anticipating and solving problems – individually, internally, and for our clients
An organized self-starter who is always eager to learn something new
Comfortable adapting to new situations and solving new problems with the pace and occasional ambiguity that occurs in high-growth businesses
A positive force who enjoys working closely with new people and exploring new ideas
Driven by seeing your work have a direct impact

Acliviti Benefits
100% coverage of employee health care, vision, and dental insurance
HSA & FSA plans available
Disability & Voluntary Benefits available
401(k) plan with a 4% employer match
Generous variable compensation opportunity
Work-from-home monthly incentive
Inclusive remote working environment

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python, React)
jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect your first project to make you the one who decides how a solution's components fit together, and the one who carries it through production. Depending on the assignment, you may:

For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery
Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it
Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs)
Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows
Make application security standards, code reviews, and test-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead
Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production
Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs
Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources
Make implementation and review faster with AI-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship

You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

7+ years of professional hands-on back-end software development experience in Python
5+ years of hands-on front-end software development experience in React.js
Bachelor's degree
A strong practical background developing cloud-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda
An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture
A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems
A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker
An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them
Direct, practical use of AI-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices
Certification in either Python or AWS
Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction

Who You Are

You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new
Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you
Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team
The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs
Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Pitch in on running Docker containers and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, from orchestration to monitoring and logging
Wire vulnerability checks, security scans, and policy controls into the delivery pipeline
Turn repeatable operational tasks into Python scripts, reaching for Bash or PowerShell when those suit better, and close out every finding that comes back

Familiarity with Docker and containerization, together with the cloud services AWS offers
Exposure to tools that express infrastructure as code, for example CloudFormation or Terraform
A basic understanding of how containers are orchestrated
Experience with the fundamentals of Linux
Knowledge of web applications and application programming interfaces, together with networking concepts and load balancing
Grounding in the principles of cloud security and in practices for delivering software securely
Skill at tracking down and resolving problems in infrastructure and in deployments
Experience generating and reviewing code with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Exposure to one or more of these areas: Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800-53 controls, or Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance
An AWS certification or practical experience delivering production workloads on AWS
A background with security tooling or vulnerability scanning, for example dynamic application security testing (DAST), policy-as-code, or static application security testing (SAST)

The care to hold up where accuracy and auditability cannot slip

jobs.description:
General Inquiries To:

Laboratory Technician (80%)

Starting 1 January 2027

How does life emerge from molecules and cells? This is the central question that motivates us. With curiosity and passion, we investigate the entire spectrum ranging from the atom to the organism. The Biozentrum of the University of Basel is one of the world’s leading life sciences institutes. With 32 groups and 500 employees, we are a dynamic and international research community that has spawned many fundamental discoveries in biology and medicine as well as several Nobel Laureates. Become part of our community!

The Bumann Lab at the Biozentrum, University of Basel, is looking for a highly motivated laboratory technician. The position is part of an SNSF Ambizione project led by Dr. Alaa Alhayek.

Your Responsibilities

The successful applicant will work closely with Dr. Alaa Alhayek on an Ambizione project investigating how Staphylococcus aureus crosses intact human skin. The project aims to identify bacterial entry routes and understand how the host contains them.

Your profile

Applicants should have a degree as “Laborant/in” or a Bachelor/Master Degree in Biology or related topics. Previous experience in cell/tissue culture, molecular biology, and microbiology is desired. Experience with human tissue, histology, confocal microscopy, RNA FISH, image analysis or biosafety level 2 work is advantageous but not required.

The role requires flexibility, reliable laboratory work, good organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Applicants should enjoy learning new methods and working in a collaborative research environment. Enthusiasm for infection biology and microscopy is essential.

We offer

The successful applicant will work closely with the Ambizione project leader while being fully integrated into the collaborative and international environment of the Bumann Lab and the Biozentrum. Training will be provided in ex vivo tissue models, microbiological methods, advanced microscopy and quantitative image analysis.

The position is available from 1 January 2027. The initial contract will be for one year.

For more information about the Bumann Lab, please visit: https://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/bumann-projects

For more information about the Ambizione project, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek email: alaa.alhayekunibasch

Application / Contact

Please apply online: https://biped.biozentrum.unibas.ch/apply/labtech_bumannlab

The application should include a brief personal statement, explaining how your qualifications and experience make you a good candidate for this job, together with a full, up-to-date CV and contact details of two references.

We start reviewing applications from 15 October 2026 until the position is filled.

Please note that only online-applications will be accepted. For further information, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek (e-mail: alaa.alhayekunibasch)

Why We’re Different:
Acliviti doesn’t just advise clients - we co-create their vision, align internal teams, and help them stay ahead of what’s next. Strategy: We help clients define where they’re going - and how to get there.

Transformation Capabilities

Role Overview

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for leading value analysis and measurement across Acliviti's CX Strategy engagements, from initial assessment and business case development through implementation and post-go-live performance measurement.

Define KPIs and measurement frameworks to track business outcomes before and after implementation.

Monitor performance trends, identify risks early, and give clear insight into what is driving client outcomes.
Play a key role in designing and building the firm’s cross-platform performance measurement approach as it evolves from analysis into a repeatable practice capability.
Work with Engineering on data connections, integrations and quality checks so performance data is accurate, documented and reliable.

Analytics, Reporting & Benchmarking

Practice Development & Knowledge Sharing

Mentor and support analysts and CX Consultants in value analysis, measurement, and reporting practices.
Continuously improve Acliviti's value measurement methodologies and analytical capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial modeling, or value/ROI analysis.
Demonstrated experience building and managing production dashboards using multiple data sources.
Experience developing ROI models and business cases to support client investment decisions.
Strong understanding of contact center, CX, and conversational AI performance metrics.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings and business value to executive stakeholders.
Experience working collaboratively across business, technology, and consulting teams.

Preferred Qualifications

new_jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python, React)
new_jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect your first project to make you the one who decides how a solution's components fit together, and the one who carries it through production. Depending on the assignment, you may:

For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery
Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it
Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs)
Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows
Make application security standards, code reviews, and test-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead
Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production
Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs
Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources
Make implementation and review faster with AI-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship

You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

7+ years of professional hands-on back-end software development experience in Python
5+ years of hands-on front-end software development experience in React.js
Bachelor's degree
A strong practical background developing cloud-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda
An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture
A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems
A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker
An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them
Direct, practical use of AI-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices
Certification in either Python or AWS
Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction

Who You Are

You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new
Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you
Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team
The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs
Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Laboratory Technician (80%)

Starting 1 January 2027

How does life emerge from molecules and cells? This is the central question that motivates us. With curiosity and passion, we investigate the entire spectrum ranging from the atom to the organism. The Biozentrum of the University of Basel is one of the world’s leading life sciences institutes. With 32 groups and 500 employees, we are a dynamic and international research community that has spawned many fundamental discoveries in biology and medicine as well as several Nobel Laureates. Become part of our community!

The Bumann Lab at the Biozentrum, University of Basel, is looking for a highly motivated laboratory technician. The position is part of an SNSF Ambizione project led by Dr. Alaa Alhayek.

Your Responsibilities

The successful applicant will work closely with Dr. Alaa Alhayek on an Ambizione project investigating how Staphylococcus aureus crosses intact human skin. The project aims to identify bacterial entry routes and understand how the host contains them.

Your profile

Applicants should have a degree as “Laborant/in” or a Bachelor/Master Degree in Biology or related topics. Previous experience in cell/tissue culture, molecular biology, and microbiology is desired. Experience with human tissue, histology, confocal microscopy, RNA FISH, image analysis or biosafety level 2 work is advantageous but not required.

The role requires flexibility, reliable laboratory work, good organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Applicants should enjoy learning new methods and working in a collaborative research environment. Enthusiasm for infection biology and microscopy is essential.

We offer

The successful applicant will work closely with the Ambizione project leader while being fully integrated into the collaborative and international environment of the Bumann Lab and the Biozentrum. Training will be provided in ex vivo tissue models, microbiological methods, advanced microscopy and quantitative image analysis.

The position is available from 1 January 2027. The initial contract will be for one year.

For more information about the Bumann Lab, please visit: https://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/bumann-projects

For more information about the Ambizione project, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek email: alaa.alhayekunibasch

Application / Contact

Please apply online: https://biped.biozentrum.unibas.ch/apply/labtech_bumannlab

The application should include a brief personal statement, explaining how your qualifications and experience make you a good candidate for this job, together with a full, up-to-date CV and contact details of two references.

We start reviewing applications from 15 October 2026 until the position is filled.

Please note that only online-applications will be accepted. For further information, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek (e-mail: alaa.alhayekunibasch)

new_jobs.title: Clinical Lab Scientist
new_jobs.description:
Responsible for maintaining the integrity of the Laboratory Information System (LIS) and implementing any functions,

projects, or procedures associated with the LIS. Implements quality standards and provides oversight of section processes

to achieve excellent outcome and quality patient care. As scheduled, performs Laboratory testing on patient and control

samples, and/or prepares blood components for transfusion. Maintains a working knowledge of departmental standard

operating procedures. This knowledge includes the use of specialized analytical instrumentation, clinical correlation of test

results, quality control requirements, and preventative maintenance. Maintains department readiness for regulatory

inspections and compliance requirements. Maintains department policy and procedure manuals in accordance with

hospital policy. Participates in the continuous quality improvement process through professional development, continuing

education, data collection and evaluation, and quality assurance. Develops and maintains orientation, training and

competency tools and ensures compliance.

Participates in data collection and analysis as requested by management. Maximizes efficiency in section operations. Exhibits willingness to resolve problems as they arise.

This position requires the full understanding and active participation in fulfilling the mission of AHMC- Anaheim Regional Medical Center and AHMC Inc. It is expected that the employee demonstrate behavior consistent with the core values of AHMC- ARMC and AHMC Inc. The employee shall support AHMC- Anaheim Regional Medical Center’s strategic plan and goals and direction of the performance improvement plan. The employee will also be expected to support all organizational expectations including, but not limited to; Customer Service, Patient’s Rights, Confidentiality of Information, Environment of Care and AHMC Inc initiatives.

Education/Training/Experience

Earned a doctoral or bachelor’s degree in a chemical, physical, biological or clinical laboratory science, or medical technology from an accredited institution or Post-baccalaureate degree certificate.

Two years experience as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist in an acute care laboratory preferred.
